items.item: Status uses a consistent vocabulary with text labels, not colour alone
items.evidence: badge() renders icon + text from one STATUS_TONE map (Draft, Withdrawn, Not started, Skipped, Submitted, In approval, Current step, Approved, Rejected); header shows 'In approval', steps show 'Approved' / 'Current step' / 'Not started'.

items.item: Approval steps show approver, decision and absolute timestamp for each level
items.evidence: stepsCard(): 'Step 1 · Line manager' + 'Approved' badge, 'Phạm Thu Hà · Sales manager', '02/11/2026 09:14'. Steps 2 and 3 show approver and status ('Current step', 'Not started') with no timestamp because no decision exists yet; timestamp is rendered as soon as s.at is set.

items.item: Approve is the single primary action; Reject is secondary and requires a reason
items.evidence: Decision card: Approve uses BTN_PRIMARY (solid blue), Reject uses BTN_REJECT (outlined). Reject opens rejectDialog() with required #rej-reason; validate() blocks submit with 'Enter a reason for rejecting this request.'

items.item: Only the current approver can act; other users see why they cannot
items.evidence: decisionCard(): if cur.who !== state.me, no Approve/Reject is rendered; shows 'Waiting for <name> (<role>)' and 'You can view this request but only the current approver can decide on it.' The 'View as' switcher demonstrates this. Requester sees Withdraw only.

items.item: Amounts are prominent, right-aligned in line items and formatted as currency
items.evidence: Total amount in the summary strip is 'text-base font-semibold tnum' (10.570.000 ₫), repeated in the Decision card. Line items and the footer total use 'text-right tnum' and Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {style:'currency', currency:'VND'}). The audit reports numericCells misaligned 0.

items.item: Attachments are listed with name, type and size and can be previewed or downloaded
items.evidence: Attachments table columns File name / Type / Size / Uploaded; e.g. 've-may-bay-VJ512.pdf  PDF  412 KB'. Each row has Preview (previewDialog, including a failure state) and Download buttons. The ZIP has Download only.

items.item: A history timeline records every action on the request
items.evidence: History tab (7 events) is a chronological table of When / Who / What / Detail covering create, field update with diff, attachments added, submit, step opened, approved with comment. approve(), reject and withdraw all push to state.events. It is rendered as a table rather than a visual timeline, but it is a full audit log.

notes: Audit score 100 with no violations. No gradients, glass, emoji, uppercase tracked labels, KPI tiles, greeting header or promo card. Light sidebar with a single blue accent; radii are small (4-6px). The approval-steps vertical rail uses small status dots, which is functional rather than decorative. The first viewport shows the Decision card and the steps but cuts off the attachments list; the full-page screenshot was not opened, and the attachments and history were judged from markup.
